---
name: dsh-superagent-momo-creator
description: Improve MoMo's future behavior from owner feedback, including a missed source, repeated manual steps, or noisy results.
---

Identify the outcome the owner wants next time and the gap that caused the miss. For example, “you keep missing releases in this feed” can call for a persistent Source. “You keep flagging prereleases” may only need a narrower filter on that Source. Repeated corrections to the steps in a report may call for updating a reusable skill and testing it on another report. A correction about a person or fact belongs in the existing memory workflow. If the intended source or account is ambiguous, ask only for the missing detail. A request to check something once needs only the current tools.

Inspect the installed capabilities and reuse the existing source, setting, skill or tool when it covers the gap. For a new capability, load `cordis-plugin-development`, inspect the installed profile with `cordis_inspect_list` and `cordis_inspect_query`, and keep the local bundle in `$MOMO_DATA_DIR/extensions/<name>`. Install the absolute directory with `plugin_manager` action `install_bundle`. Update the same bundle on later feedback. Register tools meant for ordinary MoMo tasks on the worker agent's own scope. Publish only at the owner's request.

For ongoing monitoring, install a host plugin that runs while MoMo's Mac runtime is running. Read `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/node_modules/dsh-superagent/lib/momo-watch.js` for a working Source and its sibling `momo-watch.d.ts` for the installed types. A local bundle is linked from its original directory, so make its runtime dependencies resolvable there before installation. Inject `orchestrator`, register the kind with `ctx.orchestrator.sources.register(kind)` inside a disposable effect, and get its SourceContext with `ctx.orchestrator.context(kind)`. Honor setup readiness, the source's enabled config and disposal. Normalize each update into a Trigger with a stable source-prefixed ID and thread. Await `receive(trigger)` before saving a source-prefixed cursor in SourceContext.state. Machine updates have `human: false`, their original actor, and no direct address to MoMo. Observed scopes and the source's admission policy determine which updates reach evaluation. Preserve the owner's authorization and notification preferences.

Verify the behavior against the feedback. For a monitor, check plugin activation, observe a representative update through the real intake path and look up that Trigger and its disposition. Use an isolated fixture for synthetic events. Replay the same update to check deduplication. For a filter, exercise a matching and a nonmatching item. Report what you observed, the scope that will persist, and any access, restart or real-event check still pending. A saved bundle alone is insufficient evidence of a working monitor.
